description: The keyword true as the iterator attribute names an iterator
notes: The native syntax spec lets the keywords true, false and null be read as static traversals, as references to variables of those names (see native/analysis/traversal-keyword-true), so read as a static traversal, true names the iterator. The README doesn't say how the iterator attribute is read (see native/dynamic-blocks/iterator-quoted-is-error). hashicorp/hcl reads it with hcl.AbsTraversalForExpr (expandBody.decodeSpec in ext/dynblock/expand_spec.go), which gives the literal true a traversal of its name (LiteralValueExpr.AsTraversal in hclsyntax/expression.go), so the dynamic block gets an iterator named true.
